Maîtriser le premier losange d'Éloquence: Master the first diamond of Eloquence.
Selon Plutarque, Démosthène, le plus gra: According to Plutarch, Demosthenes, the greatest orator of Athens, corrected his speech defect by talking with pebbles in his mouth, and trained his breath by declaiming while running or climbing slopes.
Maîtriser 2 compétences. L'arbre de la R: Master 2 skills. The Rhetoric tree opens.
Maîtriser la structure d'un argument. À: Master the structure of an argument. In Athens, you could have sold it.
À Athènes, chacun devait plaider lui-mêm: In Athens, everyone had to plead their own case. Those who could afford it bought a speech from a logographer, such as Lysias, who wrote it in his client's style, clumsiness included, so the judges would believe they were hearing him speak.
Maîtriser les figures de style. L'IA est: Master figures of speech. The AI is a shining light, darkening your day.
Cette obscure clarté qui tombe des étoil: That dark brightness falling from the stars.
Maîtriser l'ethos, le pathos et le logos: Master ethos, pathos and logos. Pathos is the most spectacular. Not the safest.
Accusée d'impiété, la courtisane Phryné: Accused of impiety, the courtesan Phryne was supposedly acquitted because her advocate, Hyperides, bared her breasts before the judges. The story only appears centuries later, in Athenaeus. Hyperides' speech, on the other hand, was famous for its arguments.
Maîtriser les sophismes. Vous savez main: Master fallacies. You now know when a debate is lost: at the first Godwin point.
En 1951, le philosophe Leo Strauss bapti: In 1951, the philosopher Leo Strauss named a common fallacy “reductio ad Hitlerum”: an idea would be bad because Hitler shared it. “Hitler was a vegetarian” says nothing about vegetarianism. He added that an idea is not refuted by the fact that Hitler happened to hold it.
Maîtriser l'art de réfuter et de débattr: Master the art of refuting and debating. The 1858 audience had more patience than you.
En 1858, Abraham Lincoln et Stephen Doug: In 1858, Abraham Lincoln and Stephen Douglas compete for a Senate seat in seven three-hour public debates: an hour for the first speaker, an hour and a half for the reply, half an hour to conclude. Lincoln loses the election. The debates, once published, carry him to the presidency two years later.
Aladin n'est pas dans les Mille et Une N: Aladdin is not in the Thousand and One Nights
Maîtriser l'art de raconter. Les meilleu: Master the art of storytelling. The best stories were often added after the fact.
Aladin et Ali Baba ne figurent dans aucu: Aladdin and Ali Baba appear in no early Arabic manuscript of the Thousand and One Nights. The translator Antoine Galland heard them in 1709 from a Syrian storyteller passing through Paris, Hanna Diyab, and added them to his translation. They are the two most famous tales in the collection.
Maîtriser les grands discours. Kennedy n: Master great speeches. Kennedy was not a doughnut. Neither are you.
On répète que Kennedy, en disant « Ich b: People repeat that Kennedy, by saying “Ich bin ein Berliner” in 1963, said “I am a doughnut”. That's false: the sentence is correct German, and the audience understood it as intended. The myth was born twenty years later, in the English-language press.
Maîtriser la propagande et la manipulati: Master propaganda and manipulation. The newspapers of 1938 knew how to manipulate too.
Le 30 octobre 1938, Orson Welles adapte: On October 30, 1938, Orson Welles adapts The War of the Worlds for radio. The next day, newspapers report widespread panic. Few people were listening, and almost none fled. The press, which saw radio stealing its advertising, had every interest in blowing up the story.
Réussir trois quiz d'Éloquence sans faut: Pass three Eloquence quizzes without a mistake. Short, right. Lincoln approves.
À Gettysburg, en 1863, Edward Everett pa: At Gettysburg, in 1863, Edward Everett speaks for two hours. Lincoln then delivers barely more than 270 words, in two minutes. The next day, Everett writes to him that he would be glad if he had come as near to the central idea of the occasion in two hours as Lincoln did in two minutes.
